content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Michael Cervantes (E025) requests admin access to Source Code.

Notes:
- Note 1 says full_time Analyst, recommend write.
- Note 2 says contractor with basic security training, recommend read. This note corrects the earlier full_time record.

Access policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Source Code is owned by Engineer role. Analyst is not Engineer. So admin not allowed even for full-time.

The employee is a contractor with basic security training (per the corrected note). So maximum is read.

Requested level: admin. Admin exceeds max (read). So grant maximum: read.

Decision: read.
